inclination.description: Field inclination in degrees, positive down.

declination.description: Field declination in degrees east of grid north, after caller applies convergence.

assumptions: All bands share the declared field_type. Distances are in CRS linear units.
Finite grids with gaps are plane-filled internally for FFTs; missing cells stay missing. Edge and gap artefacts may remain.
Induced magnetisation only; |inclination| must be at least 15 degrees.
Caller must supply field direction applicable to the survey date/location; declination must already be referred to grid north. No IGRF or convergence is inferred.
corrections: Does not apply IGRF, instrument, datum or observation corrections. No correction state is inferred.
